business_summary: Energy Fuels processes uranium and monazite feedstock at its White Mesa Mill in Utah, where it commissioned a Phase 1 REE separations circuit in April 2024 and demonstrated commercial-scale NdPr separation plus pilot-scale dysprosium oxide production at 99.5%+ purity. In June 2026 it agreed to acquire German magnet and alloy maker Vacuumschmelze (VAC) for approximately $1.9 billion, a deal not yet closed (expected early 2027) that would add VAC's Sumter, South Carolina magnet plant (2,000 metric tons/year, expandable to 12,000). FY2025 revenue was 65,922,000, down 15.6% from 78,114,000 in FY2024, with a widening net loss of -85,634,000.

exposure_summary.narrative: UUUU carries four ACTIVE placements on this chain, including two money-corner UNDISCOVERED links (rare-earth-separation-capacity, metal-alloy-production) on realized (White Mesa) and pending (VAC acquisition) exposure respectively, plus magnet-manufacturing-capacity (CROWDED, conditional on VAC closing) and non-china-mined-feedstock (OVER_CROWDED).
